note: Salesforce OAuth user-agent Provider adds the 'oauth' @SalesforceAuthProvider plugin; an OAuth authorization is a salesforce_auth config entity (provider=oauth, provider_settings consumer_key/consumer_secret/login_url) completed via the browser callback route salesforce.oauth_callback. Creating/authorizing an OAuth entity requires the external org + a browser (it cannot be scripted offline - saving one triggers the callback route), so the LOCAL, verifiable surface these evals use is salesforce.settings.salesforce_auth_provider (the suite's DEFAULT authorization id, which an OAuth authorization populates). Medium/hard cases set/read/clear that value, verified by pure config reads; cleanup restores it to '' (the shipped baseline).

evals.prompt: What authentication method does the Salesforce OAuth user-agent Provider add, and how does it differ from the JWT provider?
evals.expected_output: It adds the interactive OAuth user-agent flow (auth provider id 'oauth'): an admin authorizes Drupal against a Salesforce connected app in the browser, and the access/refresh token is stored. JWT, by contrast, is unattended server-to-server auth using a signing key.

evals.prompt: When setting up an OAuth Salesforce authorization, what provider settings do you configure, and what route/callback completes the flow?
evals.expected_output: An oauth salesforce_auth stores provider_settings consumer_key, consumer_secret and login_url. You create it at the salesforce.auth_config UI; completing it redirects to Salesforce and back to the salesforce.oauth_callback route, storing the token.

evals.prompt: Once I have created a Salesforce authorization, which setting tells the Salesforce suite to use it as the default authorization for API calls?
evals.expected_output: salesforce.settings.salesforce_auth_provider holds the id of the default salesforce_auth authorization used by the client.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which Salesforce authorization is configured as the default provider? Inspect the live Salesforce settings and give the id.
evals.expected_output: The default authorization is prod_oauth: salesforce.settings.salesforce_auth_provider = prod_oauth.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Salesforce settings and state the id of the currently selected default Salesforce authorization provider.
evals.expected_output: The default authorization id is sandbox_oauth: salesforce.settings.salesforce_auth_provider = sandbox_oauth.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, set the Salesforce suite's default authorization provider to the authorization with id my_oauth. Apply the change to the live site.

On this Drupal site the Salesforce default authorization provider is set to a stale id (stale_oauth) that no longer exists. Clear it so that no default authorization is selected (empty). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: salesforce.settings.salesforce_auth_provider is set to an empty string (no default provider).
